newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a very narrow range in slow trading today because most institutions stayed on the sidelines before a new treasury bond issue starting Friday.

"The market was directionless for most of the session, with only a few financial institutions borrowing money to prepare for the new seven-year bond issue," one trader said. "State banks which used to be net lenders offered less due to the issue."
Traders said the rates would move at current levels in the short term.
